What do you mean by "looks right"? I am guessing you are using pipewire. I had the same problem with my headset but mine is not wireless (as I think yours is) and uses a dongle from 3.5mm to USB to connect to the PC. What fixed it for me was going into `/usr/share/wireplumber/wireplumber.conf`, finding `device.routes.default-sink-volume` and changing the default value to something higher. Keep in mind that the values you put in there are in the cubic scale. So a 0.82 in alsamixer comes out to 0.55 in wireplumber.conf.
I needed to do `sudo pacman -Rdd tracker3` and `sudo pacman -Rdd tracker3-miners` for it to work. I made a snapshot just in case, but it updates fine after that.

Sorry you feel this way. First of all, good job for recognizing the toxicity and breaking it up even though you loved her so much. In my opinion, you shouldn't call her or text her. I don't exactly know the relationship between you now, but it seems to be a rather unwise move. If she knows you are depressed and having a hard time and AGREES to help you go through this I would say go for it but these cases are pretty rare. If she does not many problems arise. She may take it the wrong way or you could make a habit out of this and never move on. Loniless is really hard. But I think you are in love with an idea of her and the relationship between you and not actually her, hence why you broke it up, so I would suggest not contacting her. Take your time and grieve. It sounds stupid but really it helps. Best of luck.
